body:
deploybot: rollback initiated for deployment 'runtime-service' in dedicated-eu-west1

env: dedicated-eu-west1
release: v2.1.7 (commit ab12c3d)
rolling back to: v2.1.6 (commit 9f8e7d6)
reason: canary p99 latency spike + kv-cache churn
ETA: ~8m

Alex T: ack

Priya R: Any user-facing errors? logs?

deploybot: canary metrics: p99 rose from 120ms -> 380ms across 3/4 canaries; error rate unchanged; kv-miss rate +420%; trace samples: svc/runtime:trace=rt-cc3f

Jules: I'll tail the traces and validate request paths, starting now

Marina: Please pin the routing to v2.1.6 after rollback completes. Don't auto-roll forward :point_up:

Jen D: pin applied to runtime-routing config: `pin: runtime-service -> v2.1.6` (ops-git commit fd34a)

ops-bot: incident created: RED-2026-04 created, priority=P2, channel=#incidents, assignee=@eng-oncall

Priya R: thanks. any hotfix notes for release notes? what caused kv churn?

Alex T: looks like a library/driver swap in the build matrix, possible IO backpressure; need diffs

deploybot: rollback started at 2309876543; initiating sequential shutter, draining new connections, deploying v2.1.6

Jules: I see increased KV evictions at node euw1-c3 (metric: kv.evictions/sec spike at 2026-04-01T09:12:34Z)

Marina: confirm when health checks are back green before I flip traffic pin

deploybot: rollback completed at 2309876723; post-rollback health: 100% checks passing; p50/p95/p99 back to baseline. Left routing pinned to v2.1.6 for 60m. Logs:
```
[deploybot] rollback completed: runtime-service -> v2.1.6
[healthcheck] all pods ready
[kv] evictions normalized
```

Alex T: nice. create a follow-up to trace the build difference and quarantine v2.1.7 image

Priya R: opening a regression-ticket: INTG-3421. Adding sample traces and kv metrics

Jules: will follow up with trace diffs and a small reproducer in staging

Marina: Thanks all. Postmortem please include rollback timeline & who pinned

Jen D: (small correction) commit fd34a applied by me, noted in INTG-3421

deploybot: tagging thread: rollback, revert, pin. Closing notification.
